name: tg

installed.method: manual: copy the complete docs/skill/tg folder into a skills directory

notes: Original skill for the Go tg binary of this repository (replaces the older gramjs skill of the same name). Structure: SKILL.md router, references/ by topic, recipes/ with frontmatter (title, task, writes, access, commands, live_checked, tags). The command list is not copied: the skill points to `tg schema`, and `just skill-check` compares commands, flags and recipe frontmatter with the schema. Update it when the contract of schema, exit codes, output formats or the first-run steps change. Facts verified on a live account are written in the `Verified` and `Not verified` lines of each reference; recipes record the same in `live_checked` (a date, `partial` or `no`). The body is English; only trigger phrases (the `description` and the recipes' `task` field) are Russian. `scripts/tg-doctor.sh` is a read-only environment check.
